text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What's the deal here? There ain't a soul 
around. Could've sworn someone told me the 
festival was about to start.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yo, if it ain't the Three Goddesses. How's 
business treating ya, hehehe.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Well, ending up here must be some kind of 
fate. Guess I'll pay my respects.
